title: Phi-4-reasoning Technical Report
authors_zh: Marah Abdin、Sahaj Agarwal、Ahmed Awadallah、Vidhisha Balachandran、Harkirat Behl、Lingjiao Chen、Gustavo de Rosa、Suriya Gunasekar、Mojan Javaheripi、Neel Joshi、Piero Kauffmann、Arindam Mitra、Besmira Nushi、Dimitris Papailiopoulos、Guoqing Zheng

one_line: Mixture-of-Thoughts selects teachable prompts and packages teacher reasoning from several domains into a source-labeled conversation mixture.
Mixture-of-Thoughts 先挑选适合学生学习的题目，再汇集 34.9 万条跨数学、代码与科学的教师推理对话。
why: Reasoning distillation often maximizes trace volume without selecting prompts at a level where a student can learn, causing expensive demonstrations to add little usable supervision.

domains: English mathematics, coding, science, planning, and algorithmic reasoning

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reasoning distillation often maximizes trace volume without selecting prompts at a level where a student can learn, causing expensive demonstrations to add little usable supervision.

Mixture-of-Thoughts selects teachable prompts and packages teacher reasoning from several domains into a source-labeled conversation mixture. The decision boundary is whether a serialized record survives prompt teachability, complexity and diversity selection, source-level checks, and downstream training evaluation; the direct output is Mixture-of-Thoughts, consumed by Phi-4-reasoning SFT rather than an evaluation-only benchmark.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2504.21318; venue/date arXiv preprint (2025); open data Mixture-of-Thoughts at https://huggingface.co/datasets/open-r1/Mixture-of-Thoughts; scale 349,317 reasoning traces across mathematics, code, and science; full paper, official README, terms, schema, and one actual record checked on 2026-07-27.

推理蒸馏常只追求轨迹数量，却不判断题目难度是否适合学生学习，昂贵长解答因此未必形成有效监督。

该工作筛选难度与多样性合适的题目，并把多个领域的教师推理统一为带来源标签的对话混合。 判定边界是记录能否通过“可教学性、复杂度与多样性筛选，来源检查及下游训练评估”并成为Phi-4-reasoning 的监督微调的输入；直接产物是 Mixture-of-Thoughts，不是只用于评测的基准。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2504.21318，日期与状态为 2025 年预印本；开放数据为 Mixture-of-Thoughts，规模是349317 条数学、代码和科学推理轨迹；已于 2026-07-27 核验全文、官方说明、条款、字段和一条实际公开记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Mixture-of-Thoughts selects teachable prompts and packages teacher reasoning from several domains into a source-labeled conversation mixture. Relative to unfiltered long-chain distillation, it changes the reusable target to messages, token count, and source and makes prompt teachability, complexity and diversity selection, source-level checks, and downstream training evaluation the feedback boundary, so the central contribution is Track 01 data rather than a model-only, verifier-only, or benchmark-only artifact.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source and normalize the task. Input: curated teachable prompts from public reasoning sources. Operation: Normalize prompts, source identifiers, media or tools, references, and expected outputs into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject a candidate when its task input, source, access terms, or required reference is missing.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: A normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: o3-mini and related reasoning teachers generate detailed demonstrations. Output and transition: The resulting answer, rationale, or tool trace is serialized as messages, token count, and source and advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to its prompt, authoring mechanism, or required environment state.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and task-specific correctness metadata. Operation: Apply prompt teachability, complexity and diversity selection, source-level checks, and downstream training evaluation. Output and transition: Passing records form 349,317 reasoning traces across mathematics, code, and science stored as Parquet records and advance to training. Check / stop rule: Reject failed checks; final-answer agreement alone is not treated as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The pinned dataset revision and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for Phi-4-reasoning SFT and compare with unfiltered long-chain distillation. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the paper's controlled evaluation become the final artifacts. Check / stop rule: Pin the data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, seeds, and harness, and do not generalize beyond evaluated domains.

步骤 1：取得并规范任务。输入是从公开推理来源筛出的可教学题目。操作是统一题目、来源、媒体或工具、参考信息与预期输出。输出是可审计候选，随后进入目标生成。检查与停止规则是缺少任务输入、来源、使用条款或必要参考时立即拒绝。

步骤 2：写入可复用目标。输入是规范候选及其来源证据。操作是由o3-mini 等推理教师生成详细示范。输出是按“消息序列、词元数量和来源”序列化的答案、推理或工具轨迹，随后进入验证。检查与停止规则是目标无法对应题目、生成机制或必要环境状态时停止。

步骤 3：验证并打包。输入是生成目标与任务专用正确性信息。操作是执行可教学性、复杂度与多样性筛选，来源检查及下游训练评估。输出是通过检查的349317 条数学、代码和科学推理轨迹，按官方格式保存并进入训练。检查与停止规则是拒绝失败记录，且不把终答一致当作每个中间步骤都正确的证明。

步骤 4：训练并评估消费方。输入是固定版本的数据与论文基础检查点。操作是用于Phi-4-reasoning 的监督微调，并与未经筛选的长链蒸馏比较。输出是训练后模型和受控评测。检查与停止规则是固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型、随机种子与评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Decisive downstream experiment: Phi-4-reasoning, a 14B model trained on the curated demonstrations, outperforms substantially larger open-weight models across the paper's reasoning suite and approaches full DeepSeek-R1; model and data choices remain coupled. This is evidence for the complete data intervention under the reported training setup, not proof that every released record is correct.

Artifact check: the official release contains 349,317 reasoning traces across mathematics, code, and science and exposes actual fields messages, token count, and source; on 2026-07-27 its page reported 9396 downloads. Usage is only an impact cross-check, not a causal experiment.

决定性下游实验：在论文评测中，使用这些示范训练的 14B Phi-4-reasoning 超过多种更大的开放权重模型，并接近完整 DeepSeek-R1；模型和数据选择仍然耦合。 这只能支持论文报告训练设置下的完整数据干预，不能证明每条公开记录都正确。

产物核验：官方发布包含349317 条数学、代码和科学推理轨迹，实际字段是“消息序列、词元数量和来源”；2026-07-27 数据页显示 9396 次下载。使用量只作影响交叉检查，不是因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest baseline is unfiltered long-chain distillation. The paper changes the reusable object by making messages, token count, and source explicit and coupling it to prompt teachability, complexity and diversity selection, source-level checks, and downstream training evaluation. That is a direction signal because another team can train Phi-4-reasoning SFT from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是未经筛选的长链蒸馏。真正变化是把“消息序列、词元数量和来源”显式化，并与“可教学性、复杂度与多样性筛选，来源检查及下游训练评估”绑定。另一团队可直接用公开记录训练Phi-4-reasoning 的监督微调，因此它构成数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. When the closed teacher prevents complete regeneration and may embed unverifiable reasoning errors, the most serious consequence is training on a trace whose apparent correctness does not match its reasoning; reproduce a stratified record-level audit before reuse.
  2. Because the aggregate release lacks one top-level license, so source-level reuse rights differ, downstream gains may not transfer to a new domain or deployment; run source- and domain-specific evaluations rather than relying on the aggregate score.
  3. Reuse must preserve no aggregate license is declared; every upstream source term must be preserved and every upstream source or media term; exclude records whose provenance or redistribution right cannot be reconstructed.

1. 如果闭源教师无法被完整复现，也可能写入未验证的推理错误，最严重后果是把表面正确但推理不实的轨迹用于训练；复用前应按来源和难度分层抽样复核。
  2. 由于聚合发布没有统一许可，复用权利取决于各上游来源，汇总收益未必迁移到新领域或部署环境；应分别运行来源级和领域级评测。
  3. 复用必须遵守 no aggregate license is declared; every upstream source term must be preserved 及全部上游来源或媒体条款；无法重建来源和再分发权利的记录应排除。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For teams building Phi-4-reasoning SFT, pin the official revision, preserve source fields, train a fixed-backbone baseline, and output both a versioned mixture and domain-level metrics. The intervention succeeds only if the target gains survive a provenance and error audit.
  • For auditors, sample records by source and difficulty and replay prompt teachability, complexity and diversity selection, source-level checks, and downstream training evaluation. Produce a keep/reject ledger with failure reasons; do not use the dataset when licenses, task inputs, or verification artifacts are unavailable.

• 构建Phi-4-reasoning 的监督微调的团队应固定官方版本、保留来源字段、训练同骨干基线，并输出带版本的数据混合与分领域指标。只有目标收益通过来源和错误审计后，才算复用成功。
  • 数据审计者应按来源和难度抽样，重放可教学性、复杂度与多样性筛选，来源检查及下游训练评估，输出带失败原因的保留与拒绝台账。许可、任务输入或验证产物缺失时不应使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: Mixture-of-Thoughts selects teachable prompts and packages teacher reasoning from several domains into a source-labeled conversation mixture.
  • Data object: 349,317 reasoning traces across mathematics, code, and science; each record exposes messages, token count, and source.
  • Author and selector: o3-mini and related reasoning teachers generate detailed demonstrations; retention uses prompt teachability, complexity and diversity selection, source-level checks, and downstream training evaluation.
  • Evidence anchor: Phi-4-reasoning, a 14B model trained on the curated demonstrations, outperforms substantially larger open-weight models across the paper's reasoning suite and approaches full DeepSeek-R1; model and data choices remain coupled.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for Phi-4-reasoning SFT; first audit the closed teacher prevents complete regeneration and may embed unverifiable reasoning errors and the aggregate release lacks one top-level license, so source-level reuse rights differ.

• 定位：Mixture-of-Thoughts 先挑选适合学生学习的题目，再汇集 34.9 万条跨数学、代码与科学的教师推理对话。
  • 数据对象：349317 条数学、代码和科学推理轨迹，单条记录包含消息序列、词元数量和来源。
  • 生成与筛选：o3-mini 等推理教师生成详细示范，并依据可教学性、复杂度与多样性筛选，来源检查及下游训练评估保留。
  • 证据锚点：在论文评测中，使用这些示范训练的 14B Phi-4-reasoning 超过多种更大的开放权重模型，并接近完整 DeepSeek-R1；模型和数据选择仍然耦合。
  • 复用决定：适合Phi-4-reasoning 的监督微调；先审计闭源教师无法被完整复现，也可能写入未验证的推理错误和聚合发布没有统一许可，复用权利取决于各上游来源。
